    Pricing notes & legendRead before posting
    Read first: Use Target Buyout as the normal price. Post small stacks. Use Quick for fast sales and High only when supply is scarce. AH durations are 4× normal: 12h ≈ 2 days, 48h ≈ 8 days.
    Leather rule: Compare raw leather, processed leather, rare hides/scales, and finished leg armor value before converting or crafting. This server can have thin supply and weird bottlenecks.
    QuickTarget BidTarget BuyoutHigh / scarce
    * Pricing baseline: These bands are frozen reference values, not live-AH medians. Active listings show competition only and never set or raise guide prices. Use listings to choose timing and stack size; change the baseline only from qualified completed sales, exact vendor costs, deterministic conversions, or measured acquisition evidence.

    Conversion / value checks↑ Top

    Use these as quick rules before converting leather or crafting processed materials. Estimated values are guide target bands from the saved non-circular baseline, not live AH quotes.

    Item / ReferenceEstimated ValueReference / RuleDemandNotes
    Borean Leather → Heavy Borean Leather
    Wrath conversion
    		≈6g 50s per Heavy; 6 Borean input ≈4g 20sUse when Heavy Borean Leather sells above the value of the leather consumed.Very HighMain Wrath LW conversion check. Do not convert automatically if raw Borean Leather is moving faster.
    Heavy Borean Leather ↔ Arctic Fur value check
    Dalaran pattern/trade relationship
    		10 Heavy Borean ≈65g; 1 Arctic Fur ≈40gCompare 10 Heavy Borean Leather against 1 Arctic Fur before selling either item.Very HighHeavy Borean Leather and Arctic Fur can anchor each other because pattern/trade systems use them.
    Knothide Leather → Heavy Knothide Leather
    TBC conversion
    		≈3g 20s per Heavy; 5 Knothide input ≈2g 75sUse only when Heavy Knothide premium beats raw Knothide value.Med-HighGood for TBC levelers but slower than Wrath leather.
    Scraps → Leather
    Scrap cleanup
    		Borean ≈85s; Knothide ≈60s; Light ≈10sConvert scraps when the finished leather sells better than raw scraps.MedUseful for bag cleanup and low-level mats; not usually a main gold maker.
    Hide curing / older recipes
    Classic/TBC odd mats
    		Cured Light / Medium / Heavy / Thick / Rugged: ≈25s / 45s / 60s / 2g 30s / 8gCheck the exact hide, salt/thread, and cured-hide demand before crafting.Low-MedOld cured hides are niche. Singles only.

    Crafted Leatherworking items↑ Top

    This complete Horde-first catalog covers all 490 distinct tradeable Leatherworking outputs in the WotLK 3.3.5 profession data: leather conversions, armor kits, leg armors, drums, profession bags, quivers, ammo pouches, utilities, cloaks, and BoE leather/mail gear across Wrath, Outland, and Classic. The Evidence Pricing review found usable relative-rank evidence for 470 finished outputs and changed 473 bands after coverage safeguards; 3 insufficient-coverage candidates retained their prior values. All 2,856 comparison requests resolved; no current Hellscream listing set price and external gold was not copied. Fourteen leather and cured-hide intermediates retain Phase 1B material evidence, and exact 3.3.5 recipe floors remain separate craftability diagnostics. Thirty Bind on Pickup outputs, eight duplicate Alliance-only Trial records, and the already-canonical Gordok Ogre Suit remain excluded. Self-only fur linings and leg reinforcements create no tradeable item and remain excluded.

    * Evidence Pricing and craft diagnostics: The Evidence Pricing review found usable relative-rank evidence for 470 finished outputs and changed 473 bands after coverage safeguards; 3 insufficient-coverage candidates retained their prior values. All 2,856 comparison requests resolved; no current Hellscream listing set price and external gold was not copied. Fourteen leather and cured-hide intermediates retain reviewed Phase 1B material evidence. Exact 3.3.5 recipe floors remain separate craftability diagnostics: do not craft from purchased inputs when sale value is below cost. Specialization or rare-pattern access belongs in the row note and never creates a hidden surcharge.
